note: Manually-refreshed research digest compiled from public news sources, including regional/vernacular press, local TV channels and YouTube ground reports where available. Not a live news-wire feed — update this file (or re-run research) to refresh. Built for Meesho 3P logistics capacity planning (Delhivery · Shadowfax · Xpressbees): LM/FM manifestation, non-adherence hotspots, and serviceability-loss tracking. Not an official Meesho product.

Anant Chaturdashi / Ganpati Visarjan (Sep 25): mass immersion processions — major LM disruption in Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Delhi
Gandhi Jayanti (Oct 2): pan-India public holiday, 1-day dispatch/pickup slip expected nationwide
Guru Ram Das Ji Parkash Gurpurab (Oct 9): Punjab gurdwara gatherings, localized route congestion
Sharad Navratri (Oct 11-19): pan-India garba/pandal crowds — expect evening route congestion in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Delhi-NCR
Mahalaya Amavasya / Sarva Pitru Amavasya (Oct 10): final day of Pitru Paksha, precedes Sharad Navratri — marks transition into peak festive-season LM surge nationally
Durga Puja (Oct 16-20): West Bengal/Odisha/Assam pandal crowds & processions — expect major LM slowdown in Kolkata/Bhubaneswar/Guwahati
Dussehra/Vijayadashami (Oct 20): pan-India Ravana-dahan processions, route closures likely in city centers
Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti (Oct 26): regional holiday in Punjab/Haryana/Delhi, minor local market closures
Karva Chauth (Oct 29): North India evening market rush — expect last-mile delays 5-9pm in Delhi-NCR/Punjab/UP
Guru Granth Sahib Parkash Gurpurab (Nov 5): gurdwara processions in Punjab/Delhi-NCR, minor local route congestion
All Saints' & All Souls' Day (Nov 1-2): Goa/Kerala/Northeast Christian community observance, minor local impact
Diwali (Nov 8): peak-season demand surge + multi-day shop closures pan-India — plan buffer stock & extended SLA nationwide
Govardhan Puja (Nov 10): North India regional holiday, local market closures
Bhai Dooj (Nov 11): pan-India family-visit travel rush, minor LM slowdown
Chhath Puja (Nov 13-16, main day Nov 15): Bihar/UP/Jharkhand ghat gatherings — expect serviceability dip in Patna/Varanasi/Ranchi belt
Guru Nanak Gurpurab (Nov 24): Punjab-wide processions/holiday — expect statewide LM slowdown
Christmas (Dec 25): Goa/Kerala/Northeast peak demand & multi-day closures — plan buffer stock in Christian-majority belts
New Year's Day (Jan 1, 2027): pan-India public holiday, 1-day dispatch/pickup slip expected
Makar Sankranti/Pongal/Uttarayan/Lohri (Jan 14-15, 2027): pan-India harvest festival — Tamil Nadu/Gujarat/Punjab markets shut, demand spike
Shab-e-Barat (~Jan 23, 2027): night-long mosque observance in Muslim-majority pockets — minor localized evening congestion; date is moon-sighting dependent
Republic Day (Jan 26, 2027): pan-India public holiday, parade-route restrictions in state capitals
Losar / Tibetan Buddhist New Year (Feb 7, 2027): Sikkim/Ladakh/Arunachal/HP hill-town closures — expect local LM slowdown in monastery towns
Vasant Panchami (Feb 11, 2027): pan-India Saraswati Puja observance, minor local school/market closures
Ramadan begins (~Feb 9, 2027): month-long shift in market hours/footfall in Muslim-majority pockets nationwide
Maha Shivratri (Mar 6, 2027): pan-India temple-town crowds — expect local LM slowdown near major Shiva temple towns
Eid al-Fitr (~Mar 10, 2027): pan-India Muslim-majority pocket closures & demand surge — plan buffer stock in Muslim-majority belts

alerts.title: Manipur: Kangpokpi violence over Kholep arrests dug up NH-2 at Motbung; UNC's blockade of NH-2/37/202/102A still active since Sep 9
alerts.summary: A CRPF CoBRA unit's arrest of six villagers near Chawangkining/Kholep on Sep 19-20 triggered violent protests in Kangpokpi and Motbung — a CRPF vehicle was torched and protesters dug up NH-2 (Imphal-Dimapur) with JCB machines. Independently, the United Naga Council's indefinite economic blockade of NH-2, NH-37 (Imphal-Jiribam-Silchar), NH-202 (Jessami) and NH-102A (Tadubi-Ukhrul) remains in force since Sep 9, demanding justice over six Naga hostages allegedly killed by Kuki armed groups — no de-escalation signal on either front as of Sep 22.
alerts.impact: Critical serviceability loss across Manipur — all four major highway arteries remain under active blockade or fresh unrest. Flag Imphal Valley and border-district pincodes non-serviceable/high-delay; use air-cargo or alternate routing where feasible; do not commit SLA promises anywhere in Manipur until both the UNC blockade and Kangpokpi unrest de-escalate.

alerts.title: Manipur: fresh 48-hour statewide bandh called by student bodies from midnight Sep 26 over Manipur University raid arrests
alerts.summary: Student organisations have announced a fresh 48-hour statewide bandh from midnight Sep 26, demanding release of people arrested in a Manipur University raid. This follows a 24-hour NRFM bandh on Sep 21 (over the 1949 Merger Agreement) that has already lapsed, shutting shops, offices and public transport in valley districts with essential services exempted.
alerts.impact: Pre-position stock and communicate SLA delays to sellers ahead of the Sep 26 midnight start; expect a full valley-wide LM/FM shutdown for 48 hours (through Sep 28) layered on top of the ongoing NH blockades.

alerts.title: Himachal Pradesh: roadblocks ease to 51 statewide as rain tapers, Mandi (24) still worst-hit followed by Kangra, Kullu
alerts.summary: 51 roads remain blocked across Himachal Pradesh as of Sep 21, down from 59 on Sep 20 — Mandi (24), Kangra (10) and Kullu (9) remain worst-affected, with Una, Sirmaur, Lahaul-Spiti and Shimla each reporting a handful. IMD forecasts light-to-moderate rain continuing through Sep 22 before tapering, keeping slope conditions unstable on the NH-3, NH-21, NH-305, NH-505 and NH-707 corridors.
alerts.impact: Trend is improving but Mandi/Kullu/Kangra hub-to-last-mile routes still face intermittent closures — maintain buffer stock at Mandi and Kullu hubs and keep alternate routing ready through the week.

alerts.title: J&K: Doda-Bhaderwah road still blocked at Chalnai village after Sep 19 landslide, no reopening confirmed
alerts.summary: The Doda-Bhaderwah road remains blocked near Chalnai village after a landslide on September 19 halted vehicular movement between the two towns. Men and machinery remain engaged in debris-clearance, but no source confirms full restoration as of Sep 22 — the road should be treated as still disrupted.
alerts.impact: Route watch — Doda-Bhaderwah corridor: hold non-essential LM/linehaul via Chalnai until the road is confirmed cleared, and route via alternate approach roads where available for Bhaderwah-side pincodes.

alerts.title: J&K: NH-44 Ramban-Banihal stretch under daytime-only advisory; hazmat/tanker vehicles barred 7am-3pm amid widening work
alerts.summary: Very slow traffic continues on NH-44 between Ramban and Banihal due to NHAI widening work at Digdole-Khooni Nallah. Authorities are restricting inflammable-cargo tankers to a 7am-3pm window and advising daytime-only travel, citing breakdowns and landslide-prone stretches. NH-44 is the primary highway corridor for goods movement between Jammu and the Kashmir valley.
alerts.impact: Build extra transit time into First/Last Mile linehaul between Jammu and Srinagar via Ramban-Banihal; schedule hazmat-adjacent shipments within the 7am-3pm window and avoid dispatching time-sensitive shipments through this corridor at night.

alerts.title: J&K: security forces bust LeT logistics module in Rajouri's Chassana; no follow-on movement restrictions confirmed yet
alerts.summary: Police arrested three people in Rajouri district's Chassana area for allegedly harbouring terrorists linked to the 2023 Chassana encounter, recovering a pistol, grenades and an IED. No reports of curfews, checkpoints or transport restrictions stemming from this case have surfaced as of Sep 22, but security operations of this kind in the Rajouri-Poonch belt have historically preceded localized mobile-internet suspensions and movement restrictions.
alerts.impact: Watch item — Rajouri/Poonch border-belt pincodes: monitor for any follow-on movement restrictions or network curbs; no current LM/FM action needed but keep contingency routing in mind for this corridor.

alerts.title: Uttarakhand: Pithoragarh bans night traffic 6pm-6am on Ghat Bend stretch of NH-9 for 15 days after repeated stonefall injuries
alerts.summary: Continuous stonefall at Ghat Bend on the Pithoragarh-Tanakpur NH-9 injured commercial-vehicle passengers over the past week, prompting the district administration to ban vehicle movement between 6pm and 6am for at least 15 days (through roughly Oct 2). NH officials plan permanent slope treatment across a 200m stretch; NDA exam aspirants reportedly missed exam centres due to earlier closures.
alerts.impact: FM/LM movement on the Pithoragarh-Tanakpur axis must be scheduled strictly within the 6am-6pm window until at least early October; build in buffer time and avoid time-critical dispatches through this stretch during active rain.

alerts.title: Uttar Pradesh: floods steady at 26 districts, 17,544 evacuated; Bahraich's Chahalwa village still inundated from Ghaghra releases
alerts.summary: 17,544 people have been evacuated across 26 UP districts (including Ayodhya, Ballia, Barabanki, Gonda, Gorakhpur, Kanpur, Lakhimpur Kheri, Prayagraj, Varanasi and Bahraich) affecting ~3.53 lakh people, with no deaths reported — figures essentially unchanged from the prior report. Bahraich's Chahalwa village remains flooded after an upstream Nepal barrage release of ~3.79 lakh cusecs into the Ghaghra; 1,312 flood shelters and 1,697 boats remain deployed statewide.
alerts.impact: Sustain existing contingency routing for hubs in Gorakhpur, Ayodhya, Varanasi, Prayagraj and the Bahraich/Sharda Barrage belt — no signs of imminent resolution; keep buffer stock at district hubs.

alerts.title: Punjab: PRTC/PUNBUS/Roadways contract-worker chakka jam still deferred, awaiting Sep 24 Transport Minister meeting
alerts.summary: Contract workers of Punjab Roadways, PUNBUS and PRTC deferred their planned Sep 22 chakka jam and are continuing operations pending a Transport Minister meeting on Sep 24, after partial consensus with the Transport Secretary on outsourced-to-contract conversion. As of Sep 22 the meeting has not yet occurred, so no outcome is available.
alerts.impact: No disruption currently. Flag Sep 24 as a hard checkpoint — if talks fail, an indefinite chakka jam could hit state roadways/bus corridors used for FM/LM in Ludhiana, Jalandhar, Amritsar and Patiala; pre-stage alternate transport ahead of that date.

alerts.title: Punjab: Kisan Mazdoor Morcha farmers block rail tracks at Gurdaspur, Amritsar, Moga, Firozepur, Sangrur over MSP demand
alerts.summary: Since around Sep 15, farmers under the Kisan Mazdoor Morcha have blocked rail tracks at five Punjab locations — Gurdaspur, Amritsar, Moga, Firozepur and Sangrur — demanding legal MSP guarantees on basmati, mustard, potatoes, moong and maize, plus debt relief and withdrawal of the land pooling policy. Multiple trains (Amritsar-New Jalpaiguri, Amritsar-Jaynagar Shaheed Express, Nangal Dam Express, Amritsar-Kadian) have been diverted; no confirmed end date as of Sep 22.
alerts.impact: Rail-linked freight through Amritsar, Moga, Firozepur and Sangrur corridors faces delays/diversions — prefer road linehaul for these hubs until the blockade lifts.

alerts.title: IMD flags fresh heavy rain for Delhi-NCR, UP and Rajasthan on Sep 22 even as Punjab/Haryana turn dry ahead of monsoon withdrawal
alerts.summary: IMD's Sep 21 bulletin warns of heavy rain and thunderstorms for Delhi-NCR, UP and Rajasthan on Sep 22, even as Punjab and Haryana entered a dry spell from Sep 20 with the monsoon beginning withdrawal from west Rajasthan (two days later than normal).
alerts.impact: Punjab/Haryana LM/FM operations should see improving conditions; keep watch on Delhi-NCR and UP/Rajasthan hub pincodes for fresh waterlogging-driven delays through Sep 22-23.

alerts.title: Mumbai: heavy-vehicle bans on JVLR, NH-66 and Vasai-Virar confirmed for Anant Chaturdashi visarjan, Sep 25-26
alerts.summary: Traffic police have confirmed timings for the final Ganesh immersion: JVLR heavy-vehicle ban from 10:00 AM Sep 25 to 12:00 PM Sep 26; NH-66 (Mumbai-Goa highway) ban on vehicles ≥16 tonnes from 08:00 hrs Sep 25 to 20:00 hrs Sep 26; and a Vasai-Virar zone (Vasai, Nalasopara, Naigaon) restriction from 2 PM to midnight on immersion days. LPG, milk, medicine, fuel and JNPT/Jaigarh port carriers are exempted.
alerts.impact: Plan FM/LM linehaul on JVLR, NH-66 and Vasai-Virar corridors around these windows; pre-position or reroute non-exempt heavy vehicles via alternate routes to avoid multi-hour idling during peak immersion procession hours.

alerts.title: Maharashtra: Sindhudurg-Ratnagiri brace for heavy rain/winds Sep 22-23, renewed landslide risk at Raghuveer Ghat (Khed taluka)
alerts.summary: IMD warns of isolated heavy rain with thunderstorms and 30-50 kmph winds over Konkan and Goa on Sep 22-23, concentrated on Sindhudurg and Ratnagiri. This raises fresh slope-stability concerns at Raghuveer Ghat (Khed taluka, Ratnagiri) — site of a major Sep 4 landslide that severed 15-20 villages and blocked the Ratnagiri-Satara road for days; the ghat had already been closed to tourists into August over road damage.
alerts.impact: Maintain contingency routing around Raghuveer Ghat (Ratnagiri-Satara link) and monitor NH-66 through Sindhudurg/Ratnagiri for possible fresh blockages; FM pickups in Khed taluka villages remain at risk of connectivity loss if rain intensifies as forecast.

alerts.title: Maharashtra: IMD yellow alert for 26 districts incl. Mumbai, Thane, Raigad, Pune, Nagpur through Sep 25 as Bay system feeds rain
alerts.summary: IMD has issued a yellow alert for light-to-moderate rain across 26 districts — Palghar, Thane, Mumbai, Raigad, Ratnagiri, Jalgaon, Nashik, Pune, Satara, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Nagpur and 10 Vidarbha districts. Marathwada is expected to see fairly widespread rain Sep 22, intensifying to very/extremely heavy spells Sep 23-24, driven by the Bay of Bengal system tracking toward Odisha-AP.
alerts.impact: Expect intermittent LM delivery delays and FM pickup slippage across Mumbai/Thane/Pune/Nagpur hubs; build in buffer for Marathwada and Vidarbha linehaul Sep 22-25.

alerts.title: Gujarat: yellow alert for Dwarka, Jamnagar, Porbandar, Junagadh, Rajkot as monsoon withdrawal stalls over Saurashtra-Kutch
alerts.summary: IMD has issued a yellow alert for heavy rain and gusty winds in five Saurashtra districts — Dwarka, Jamnagar, Porbandar, Junagadh and Rajkot — as a revived coastal low delays monsoon withdrawal from the region. Withdrawal has begun from western Rajasthan but Saurashtra-Kutch remains under active flash-flood watch, with fishermen warned off the Arabian Sea coast.
alerts.impact: Expect rain-linked slowdowns for FM pickups in Rajkot, Jamnagar and Junagadh belts; downgrade this watch only once monsoon withdrawal is confirmed complete over the region.

alerts.title: Gujarat: Ahmedabad's Mithakhali underpass shut for 102 minutes as moderate rain reflows chronic waterlogging spots
alerts.summary: Renewed rain on Sep 19-21 waterlogged Ahmedabad's chronic choke points again — the Mithakhali underpass was closed for 102 minutes after just 0.55 inches of rain, and SG Highway, Shahibaug, Parimal and Vatva GIDC/Vastral saw flooding.
alerts.impact: Continue routing FM/LM vehicles away from Mithakhali, SG Highway and Vatva GIDC underpasses during rain windows; expect recurring short-duration (60-120 min) closures rather than multi-day disruption.

alerts.title: Kerala: monsoon toll reaches 10 after fresh Kottayam landslide kills tourist; orange alert across six districts, fishing banned
alerts.summary: Kerala's combined monsoon toll has risen to around 10 after a fresh landslide at Velathusseri near Teekoy (Kottayam) killed a 35-year-old Chennai tourist, Sangeetha Arul Lal, on Sep 21 — on top of the Idukki landslide (2 dead) and the Malappuram/Nilambur flash flood (5 dead, 1 missing). IMD orange alert remains in force for Pathanamthitta, Alappuzha, Kottayam, Idukki, Ernakulam and Thrissur; a statewide fishing ban continues and CM V.D. Satheesan has ordered hourly situation assessments.
alerts.impact: Statewide caution across all orange-alert districts — hold non-essential LM movement in low-lying and hill-adjacent pincodes, verify addresses before dispatch, and keep buffer stock at Kochi/Thrissur/Kottayam hubs until the alert is downgraded.

alerts.title: Kerala: landslide buries plantation shed at Kottakamboor, Vattavada (Idukki High Ranges), kills two named plantation workers
alerts.summary: A landslide struck Kottakamboor in Vattavada (Devikulam taluk, Idukki) around 5pm Sep 20, killing garlic-farming workers Balakrishnan and Chinnu while sheltering from rain; a third worker was critically injured and admitted to Adimali Taluk Hospital. District minister Anoop Jacob has pledged government-funded treatment and family assistance.
alerts.impact: Serviceability risk — Idukki High Ranges (Vattavada, Pampadumchola, Kottakamboor, Kadavari route): flag as high landslide-risk, hold non-essential LM movement on hill roads during active rain, and pre-position buffer stock at the Munnar/Idukki hub.

alerts.title: Kerala: Nilambur flash-flood toll at 5, search for missing Sajitha resumes at Kottapuzha river (TK Colony)
alerts.summary: The Sep 20 flash flood on the Kottapuzha river (Ularvattam-TK Colony stretch, between Chokkad and Amarambalam panchayats, Nilambur) swept away 9 people — the toll rose to 5 after two more bodies were recovered Monday morning. Sajitha of TK Colony, who was washing clothes riverside, remains missing; Fire Force and police resumed the search Tuesday morning (Sep 22) after strong currents halted Monday's operation.
alerts.impact: Flag Nilambur/Malappuram river-adjacent pincodes and forest-catchment-fed streams for flash-flood risk even absent local rain — hold LM movement near riverside routes and verify road conditions before dispatch into Nilambur taluk.

alerts.title: Karnataka: Agumbe Ghat (NH-169A) heavy-vehicle ban stays in force through September 30 on landslide risk
alerts.summary: Udupi's Deputy Commissioner has kept the Section 115 MV Act order banning heavy vehicles on NH-169A's Agumbe Ghat stretch in force until September 30 due to landslide risk; heavy vehicles are diverted via Thirthahalli-Nagar-Kundapur-Udupi.
alerts.impact: Standing routing constraint — avoid heavy-vehicle linehaul on Agumbe Ghat through Sep 30; use the Thirthahalli-Nagar-Kundapur-Udupi diversion for the Shivamogga-Udupi corridor FM/LM until the ban lifts.

alerts.title: Karnataka: heavy rain alert for coastal/Malnad belt (Dakshina Kannada, Udupi, Kodagu, Chikkamagaluru), Bengaluru evening showers
alerts.summary: IMD Bengaluru has flagged heavy rain with thunderstorms for the coastal and Malnad regions — Dakshina Kannada, Udupi, Kodagu, Chikkamagaluru and the Shivamogga belt — on Sep 21-22, with Bengaluru itself expecting cloudy skies and evening showers.
alerts.impact: Minor slip-risk watch for Malnad/coastal ghat sections (Charmadi, Shiradi) alongside the existing Agumbe ban; limited direct LM impact expected in Bengaluru city.

alerts.title: Tamil Nadu: heavy rain across 21 districts (Nilgiris, Coimbatore, Thanjavur, Madurai) begins easing from Sep 22
alerts.summary: The Regional Meteorological Centre's heavy-rain forecast for 21 Tamil Nadu districts — Nilgiris, Coimbatore, Dindigul, Thanjavur, Nagapattinam, Madurai, Cuddalore, Vellore, Tiruchirappalli and others — driven by a low-pressure area over the north Andaman Sea, is now forecast to ease statewide from Tuesday (Sep 22), though moderate rain continues over the Western Ghats.
alerts.impact: Route watch downgrading — hill-taluka (Nilgiris, Dindigul) and low-lying delta pincodes (Thanjavur, Nagapattinam) should see improving conditions through the week; monitor Chennai for any residual waterlogging.

alerts.title: Telangana: heavy-to-very-heavy rain warning widens to ~20 districts for Sep 23-26 as Bay of Bengal system nears deep-depression stage
alerts.summary: IMD Hyderabad has widened its heavy-to-very-heavy rainfall warning (64.4-204.4mm, squally winds 50-60kmph) for Sep 23-26 to roughly 20 districts including Adilabad, Karimnagar, Khammam, Mahabubabad, Nizamabad, Warangal and Hanumakonda, with an orange alert for north/east Telangana expecting 10cm+ rain Sep 23-25, tied to the incoming Bay of Bengal deep depression.
alerts.impact: Pre-position buffer stock in the Warangal-Karimnagar-Khammam belt ahead of Sep 23; Hyderabad already saw waterlogging Sep 21-22 (Kapra, Musheerabad) from early rain bands — expect further delays through Sep 26.

alerts.title: Bay of Bengal deep depression (potential Cyclone 'Arnab') to reach north AP-south Odisha coast Sep 23 forenoon; red alert widens to Kalahandi, Rayagada
alerts.summary: IMD's latest bulletin confirms the Bay of Bengal low is intensifying toward deep-depression strength — not yet officially named 'Arnab' — and is very likely to reach near the north Andhra Pradesh-south Odisha coast around the forenoon of Sep 23, with landfall possible between the night of Sep 23 and morning of Sep 25. Red alert for extremely heavy rain (20cm+) covers Odisha's Kandhamal, Gajapati, Ganjam and Puri on Sep 23, with Kalahandi and Rayagada added for Sep 23-25; squally winds of 55-65 kmph gusting to 75 kmph expected. 42 ODRAF and 24 NDRF teams are deployed to Gajapati, Ganjam, Rayagada, Koraput, Malkangiri, Nabarangpur and Kandhamal; fishermen are barred from the sea through Sep 24.
alerts.impact: Pre-position for Sep 23 landfall — Ganjam/Puri/Gajapati/Kandhamal/Kalahandi/Rayagada (Odisha) and north coastal AP hubs should pre-build 3-4 day buffer stock, suspend fishing-belt LM attempts, and prepare to flag NS for low-lying coastal pincodes from Sep 22 evening. Telangana, AP interior, West Bengal coastal and Jharkhand southern/eastern hubs should expect wind/rain-related delays through Sep 25.

alerts.title: Odisha: five villages marooned in Sundargarh's Bonai block as Sarasara, Patang bridges near Balang submerge
alerts.summary: At least five villages are marooned in Sundargarh district's Bonai block after floodwaters submerged the Sarasara and Patang bridges near Balang, consistent with earlier reports of families stranded near the Rukuda Dam catchment. Brahmani, Baitarani and Subarnarekha overflow continues to hit Balasore, Bhadrak, Jajpur, Mayurbhanj, Keonjhar and Kendrapara, with orange/yellow alerts also covering Koraput, Rayagada, Ganjam and Puri ahead of the incoming Bay of Bengal deep depression.
alerts.impact: Bonai block (Sundargarh) LM delivery routes are impassable — treat as non-serviceable until floodwaters recede and bridges are confirmed clear; pre-build buffer stock at Rourkela hub given the compounding cyclone landfall on Sep 23.

alerts.title: Odisha: Malkangiri effectively cut off as Kanyashram, Poteru, Pangam, Kankurukonda bridges go under; NH-326 halted
alerts.summary: Nearly three feet of floodwater is flowing over the Kanyashram Bridge, cutting Kalimela-Padiya connectivity and links to Chhattisgarh. Multiple bridges (Poteru, Pangam, Kankurukonda, Kanyashram, MV-96) are submerged under 2-3 feet of water and NH-326 traffic has halted amid a fresh low-pressure system ahead of the incoming deep depression/cyclone.
alerts.impact: Malkangiri district is effectively cut off for LM/FM road transport; hold dispatches and flag non-serviceable pincodes until bridges clear — expect further worsening as the Sep 23 system brings additional rain.

alerts.title: Jharkhand: flash-flood alert spans 14 districts ahead of Sep 24 orange alert (Gumla, Simdega, Ranchi, Khunti, West Singhbhum)
alerts.summary: IMD's flash-flood alert, tied to the same Bay of Bengal system affecting Odisha, covers a yellow alert for 11 districts on Sep 23, escalating to orange alert for 5 districts (Gumla, Simdega, Ranchi, Khunti, West Singhbhum) on Sep 24, with heavy-to-very-heavy rain also flagged for Latehar, Lohardaga, Ramgarh, Hazaribag, Koderma, Giridih, Bokaro, Dhanbad and Saraikela-Kharswan.
alerts.impact: Pre-position buffer stock at Ranchi and West Singhbhum hubs ahead of Sep 23-24; flag Gumla/Simdega/Khunti rural pincodes for likely LM delay once the orange alert takes effect.

alerts.title: Bihar: embankment breaches at Baniya (Rangra) and Gopalpur, Bhagalpur, as Ganga floods affect over 4 million across 14 districts
alerts.summary: About 15 metres of an old rail embankment near Baniya village (Rangra Chowk block, Naugachia) collapsed under Kosi floodwater pressure, threatening Sadhopur, Masudanpur, Baisi and Bhawanipur panchayats; a second ~10-metre breach hit the Brahmottar embankment at Gopalpur. The Ganga has broken its all-time high-water record at multiple gauge stations including Gandhi Ghat, Patna, with 3.4-4 million people affected across 13-14 districts including Bhagalpur, Munger, Begusarai, Katihar and Khagaria.
alerts.impact: Critical serviceability loss — flag Naugachia subdivision (Baniya, Sadhopur, Masudanpur, Baisi, Bhawanipur, Gopalpur) and other breach-affected panchayats non-serviceable until water recedes from record levels; route Bhagalpur/Patna-hub linehaul with heavy buffer through end of September.

alerts.title: West Bengal: Padma erosion destroys 10 houses and Manasa temple in Radhakrishnapur village, Raghunathganj (Murshidabad)
alerts.summary: Padma River erosion destroyed over 10 houses and the old Manasa temple within hours in Radhakrishnapur village (Raghunathganj police station, Murshidabad) overnight Sunday into Monday — the river advanced roughly 200 metres inland in a single night; families are sheltering at Kalinagar Primary School and the Sekalipur flood shelter. Other affected Murshidabad blocks include Farakka, Samserganj, Suti I/II, Lalgola, Bhagawangola I/II, Raninagar I/II and Jalangi. Irrigation officials expect erosion to continue through end-September.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss — flag Radhakrishnapur and adjoining Raghunathganj-belt pincodes non-serviceable as addresses become invalid with active home loss; recommend manual verification calls before LM attempts and route via Murshidabad/English Bazar hubs with extra buffer through end-September.

alerts.title: West Bengal: fresh Ganga erosion in Malda's Manikchak washes away ~50 houses; Kaliachak, Ratua blocks also hit
alerts.summary: Fresh Ganga erosion in Malda's Manikchak block has washed away roughly 50 houses near Shantimor/Gopalpur, triggering panic among residents; Kaliachak I & II and Ratua I & II blocks are also affected. All 69 gates of the Indrapuri Barrage have been opened, and ₹3,600 crore has been allotted for anti-erosion works across Malda, Murshidabad and Nadia.
alerts.impact: Flag Manikchak/Kaliachak/Ratua block pincodes non-serviceable as addresses become invalid; recommend manual verification calls before LM attempts and route via Malda town hub with extra buffer through end-September.

alerts.title: West Bengal: landslide at Mangtabong village, Yuksom Bazar damages homes/livestock; NH-10 sees recurring diversions
alerts.summary: Heavy overnight rain on Sep 18 triggered a major landslide at Mangtabong village (Tsong Dubdi Ward, 07-Yuksam Dubdi GPU) near Yuksom Bazar, damaging houses and killing livestock. Kalimpong district administration continues to advise avoiding NH-10 during heavy rain and using alternate routes; the situation is likely to intensify once South Bengal's heavy rain arrives from the incoming Bay of Bengal system.
alerts.impact: Route watch — Darjeeling-Kalimpong hill pincodes, Yuksom/West Sikkim border belt and the NH-10 corridor: keep buffer time for LM/linehaul, verify Yuksom-area addresses before dispatch.

alerts.title: Nagaland: NH-702 partially reopens for light vehicles between Changtongya and Longleng; heavy vehicles still suspended
alerts.summary: The Sep 11-12 landslide on NH-702 between Changtongya and Longleng (chainage 5+785-6+050) has been partially cleared — light vehicles are permitted, but heavy-vehicle movement remains suspended since Sep 12 as recurring mudslides slow NHIDCL/contractor debris-clearance work. The alternate Tangha-Kangching-Merangkong diversion road is also unsuitable for heavy vehicles.
alerts.impact: Light-parcel LM/FM movement can resume via NH-702 or the Tangha-Kangching-Merangkong diversion, but hold all heavy-vehicle linehaul and keep buffer stock at the Changtongya gateway until full restoration.

alerts.title: Mizoram: Kolasib district landslide kills 14-year-old in Vairengte; Sialsuk villagers sheltering 500+ stranded travellers
alerts.summary: A landslide near the Assam border killed 14-year-old Zodingliana and injured four in Vairengte town (Sep 12); continuous rain has since triggered further precautionary evacuations across Kolasib district: 13 families moved from Saihapui 'K' over Tuichhuahen river flood fears, families evacuated in North Chawnpui amid fears of the Serlui 'B' hydro dam overflowing, a house destroyed by landslide in Kolasib town's Khuangpuilam locality, and 3 families evacuated from Pangbalkawn after homes were left structurally unsafe. Villagers in Sialsuk are sheltering more than 500 stranded travellers cut off by disrupted roads.
alerts.impact: Watch list — Vairengte, Saihapui 'K', North Chawnpui, Kolasib town, Pangbalkawn and Sialsuk: flag as landslide/flood-risk during active rain, hold non-essential LM movement on hill-slope approach roads near the Tuichhuahen river, and verify addresses in slide-prone pockets before dispatch.

alerts.title: Sikkim: NH-10 continues one-way traffic at Bardang (20th Mile) after landslide; 12 households affected, secondary roads still disrupted
alerts.summary: The Sep 17 landslide at Bardang (20th Mile) on NH-10 — Sikkim's sole highway artery to Siliguri and the plains — reopened to one-way traffic on Sep 20, though full two-way restoration is still pending; SDM reports confirm 12 households affected with relief disbursed. Secondary roads remain blocked or on single-lane diversion across Gangtok, Pakyong, Mangan, Namchi, Gyalshing and Soreng districts, including the Singtam road at Aapdara/Marchak and the Dikchu-Mangan road at Zin Khola.
alerts.impact: NH-10 is Sikkim's only major supply corridor; expect continued delay from one-way regulation at Bardang, pre-position buffer stock at the Siliguri gateway, and flag Gyalshing/Soreng/Namchi hill pincodes for LM delay until secondary roads clear and NH-10 returns to two-way traffic.

alerts.title: Arunachal Pradesh: Zemithang-Tawang and Balipara-Chariduar-Tawang roads still risk-prone after landslides stranded hundreds
alerts.summary: A landslide near Shakti village cut the Zemithang-Tawang road in Tawang district, while a separate landslide near Padma Hotel/Sapper Camp in West Kameng's Dirang subdivision blocked the strategic Balipara-Chariduar-Tawang (BCT) road, damaging two vehicles and stranding hundreds at 35 Charai and Jamiri, with further blockades at Jyoti Nagar, Dirang, Padma and Durga Mandir. BRO has cleared and restored at least one stretch, but full end-to-end confirmation for both roads is not yet available.
alerts.impact: Serviceability risk — Tawang and West Kameng border pincodes have limited alternate routing; expect continued LM/FM delays and hold heavy shipments until NHIDCL/BRO confirms both stretches fully cleared.

alerts.title: Assam: Brahmaputra erosion at Majuli's Bhakat Chapori threatens 16 villages; Chabua's Balijan tea garden erosion sparks resident oil-blockade protest
alerts.summary: Severe Brahmaputra erosion in Majuli Island's Bhakat Chapori area now threatens 16 villages including lower Majuli, with parts of Mohorichuk and Charighoria already swallowed by the river. In Chabua's Balijan area, erosion destroyed crores of rupees' worth of geo-bag riverbank protection work in a single day, directly hitting the Balijan tea garden — local residents staged an oil blockade in protest against inadequate erosion-control measures.
alerts.impact: Serviceability risk — flag Majuli Island (Bhakat Chapori, Mohorichuk, Charighoria) and Chabua/Balijan riverside pincodes for active road/address instability; monitor for localized protest blockades near Chabua/Dibrugarh corridor and verify access routes before dispatch.
